profile.title: My referee profile
profile.nameReadOnlyHint: Your name, date of birth and club appear on your digital referee card or determine who assigns you, so they are read-only here. If something is wrong, submit a correction request: it goes to the referee committee of your state association and is applied once approved.
profile.phoneHint: The phone number is used by the RSK solely in urgent cases during assignment. It is not shared with third parties or used for any other purpose.
profile.assignmentInfoHint: This information comes from your profile and is used solely for referee assignment.
profile.shortNoticeMobile: I am available at short notice
profile.shortNoticeMobileHint: Enable this if you can step in for assignments at short notice (mobile).
profile.addressHint: Only used for distance calculation when assigning games.
profile.partnerHint: Enter the license number of your primary partner here. This moves that person to the top of the assignment's selection field and thus speeds up assigning; if they have registered availability for the match day and are not already assigned elsewhere, they are suggested for the second slot. This is not a wish list: anyone missing here is assigned just the same, and no restriction follows from it. The decision stays with the assignment. One number is enough, other frequent partners appear at the top anyway – they come from your past joint appearances according to the game reports. At most five names are listed at the top.
profile.emailReadOnlyHint: Your email address is managed centrally in your user account. Changing it there also updates the address used for assignment and RSK emails.
profile.emailDiverged: Note: your login currently uses {{accountEmail}}. Once you change and confirm the address under “My account”, both addresses are merged.
profile.exclusionsHint: Clubs whose games you do not want to be assigned to. Your own club is always on the list. You can request further clubs with a short reason, as well as the removal of a requested club. The list is a hint for the assigners, not a technical block.
profile.qualificationsHint: These entries are maintained by the referee commission and also appear on your digital referee card and in the public licence check. If a qualification is wrong or missing, contact the referee commission of your state association.

card.title: My card
card.disclaimer: This card was issued by Floorball-Verband Deutschland e. V. Validity and license level can be checked via the QR code or at saisonmanager.de/lizenzcheck. From iOS 27 and Android 8 onwards, you can also import this QR code into your official wallet app. To do so, open your wallet app and follow the instructions there.

history.title: My history
history.disclaimer: Please note that data collection through the 2025/2026 season was very inconsistent and entries may be missing. If you have officiated games that don't appear here, you can report them to it@floorball.de, naming your refereeing partner and including the link to the match.

availabilities.title: My availability
availabilities.intro: Click a day to mark yourself as available or to remove the mark. For a range: click the first day, then click the last day. Assigners can only schedule you on days you have marked as available.
availabilities.pastAvailable: Past day – you had reported availability (read-only)

gameDays.title: My match days
gameDays.intro: If your state association has set up a match day checklist, confirm your match days here as properly conducted – or report them as not properly conducted and answer the checklist. Confirmation is possible from the start of the last game. Without confirmation within 48 hours, a match day is automatically considered confirmed.
gameDays.checklistHint: Please answer every question. If you answer "No", the responsible game operations committee will be notified.
gameDays.reportedImproperAt: Reported as not properly conducted on {{ date }}
gameDays.notesTitle: Additional game information from the assigner

notifications.correctionRequested: Correction request sent to your state association.
